skills.name: data-foundations
skills.input_contract: Population, sample, observation unit, variable types, units, collection purpose and quality observations.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: No causal, representative-sampling, or inferential guarantees from a descriptive dataset.

skills.name: data-presentation
skills.input_contract: Question, variable roles, observation pairs/time ordering, class boundaries, units, counts and chart convention.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: No invented scatter data; no unqualified attribution of unlabeled pie slices or unspecified whiskers.

skills.name: central-tendency
skills.input_contract: Numeric/ordered/categorical values as appropriate, observation unit, units, scope, dataset identity, weights or grouped boundaries when needed.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: Slide 7/41 notation discrepancies; grouped quantities are approximations; center alone does not describe stability.

skills.name: data-dispersion
skills.input_contract: Quantitative values, dataset identity/version, scope, units, prior center provenance; quantile and shape definitions when requested.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: Source slide 60 conflicts with the sample formula; one-observation sample variance and zero-SD standardized scores are undefined.

skills.name: sample-space-events
skills.input_contract: Experiment, allowed outcomes, event predicates, constraints and relevant local symbol meanings.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: Finite enumeration is practical only for bounded spaces; no default equal-likelihood assumption.

skills.name: counting-principles
skills.input_contract: Stage alternatives, distinguishability, all restrictions, repetition rules and universe identity.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: Raw products fail when restrictions change branch counts; unspecified forbidden rules cannot be guessed.

skills.name: permutations
skills.input_contract: n, selection size, identity/distinctness, order, replacement, multiplicities and constraints.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: Slide 31 prose/formula mismatch; no generic factorial shortcut for arbitrary dependency schedules.

skills.name: combinations
skills.input_contract: n, group size, distinct objects, order/replacement rules and restrictions.
skills.output_contract: Identity, results, assumptions, evidence, checks, unresolved dependencies
skills.known_limitations: No automatic coverage of combinations with replacement, distributions, or probability assignments.
